item.title: Training course: EUMETSAT/ECMWF NWP-SAF satellite data assimilation — ECMWF Events (Indico)
item.description: Dates: 18 Jan – 22 Jan 2027 · 5 days. Location: ECMWF, Reading. Deadline: 2026-10-11. Fee EUR 0 · Apply on official page. Topics: satellite, machine learning

item.title: Winter School on Federalism and Governance 2027 — Eurac Research and University of Innsbruck
item.description: Dates: 1 Feb – 12 Feb 2027 · 12 days. Location: Innsbruck / Bolzano/Bozen. Deadline: 2026-10-12. EUR 300 participation fee, excluding accommodation · Limited scholarships: 2 full and 3 partial; recipients still pay EUR 150. Full: accommodation, breakfast and a small travel contribution; partial: accommodation and breakfast. · Apply on official page. Topics: law, political science, AI governance

item.title: VIASM-IAMP Summer School 2027 on Probability and Mathematical Physics — International Research Laboratory France-Vietnam in Mathematics and its Applications, University of Tours; Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM)
item.description: Dates: 23 Jul – 28 Jul 2027 · 6 days. Location: Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM), Hanoi. Deadline: 2027-07-01. Registration: free · Accommodation, meals and travel support: not stated. Topics: probability, mathematical physics, statistical physics, mathematics

item.title: ALPS 2027 — Advanced Language Processing Winter School — LIG (Université Grenoble Alpes) and NAVER Labs Europe
item.description: Dates: 28 Mar – 2 Apr 2027 · 6 days. Location: Europe. Deadline: 2026-10-11. EUR 700 students; EUR 900 academic non-students; EUR 1300 industry and independents (to be confirmed; includes accommodation and full board) · Apply on official page. Topics: natural language processing
